name: Back Office Helper
description: Analyzes and builds accessible cases through approved Back Office MCP tools, using one engine for loans and account opening with subjects separate from reviewers.

skills.name: Back Office case queries
skills.description: Find a person's assigned document sets and explain current outstanding requirements with evidence references.
examples: What documents is this person missing?
Which document sets are assigned to this person?

skills.name: Case analysis and building
skills.description: Resolve subjects, create typed cases pinned to permitted Document Set versions, process existing sources, link evidence and run shared evaluations through approved MCP tools. Keep staff responsibility separate from subjects.
examples: Analyze the outstanding findings for this loan case.
Build an account-opening case for this subject using the permitted Document Set and existing evidence.
